articles.title: Pokémon Scalper Reportedly Arrested After Punching Man in the Face Over 30th Anniversary Target Drop
articles.summary: A Pokémon scalper has reportedly been arrested and trespassed after punching a man in a viral confrontation that resulted in a four-year-old child getting hurt in the chaos. A Target store in Lisbon, Connecticut is at the center of a viral incident that occurred on August 28, 2026.
body: The person who recorded the footage confronted the duo along with his girlfriend, who submitted the footage to PokéStreetz, an account dedicated to exposing bad behavior within the Pokémon TCG community.

In the footage, the four parties argued about the amount of merchandise the scalpers were making off with; the scalpers themselves proudly said, “Damn straight” that they were checking out with all that merch, rather than abiding by the two-per-person limit enacted by Target, and warned the couple not to touch their shopping cart.

The recorder and his girlfriend continued to follow the scalpers up to a self-checkout station, where one of the scalpers decked the recorder in the face, causing him to drop his phone on the ground. Scuffling can be heard in the background, along with a child crying.

PokéStreetz claimed that the recorder fell into this child, a four-year-old girl, after being punched by the scalper. The girl also reportedly fell in the impact and hurt her elbow; although the recorder “immediately” went to check up on the girl, the scalper fled, allegedly leaving his wallet behind.

articles.title: Star Wars Encyclopedias Are Deeply Discounted for Amazon Prime Members Right Now
articles.summary: Amazon recently announced the dates for its Prime Big Deal Days sale, and while it's still a couple weeks away, there are already some great early deals available for Prime members.
body: You don't need to be really into Star Wars to understand why these encyclopedias make for a great gift for fans of the movies. After all, who wouldn't want to see a cross-section of an X-Wing or a massive AT-AT Walker?

All of the encyclopedias currently on sale are either at their lowest prices ever or the lowest price in 2026 to-date. Each of the books I've featured here are the hardcover editions that include full-color illustrations, pictures, and additional artwork inside.

Based on the preview images for each book, the encyclopedias appear to be rooted in Disney's version of Star Wars canon, which excludes anything outside of George Lucas' Star Wars trilogies and the Disney TV shows and movies that followed. That means you shouldn't expect to see characters or things featured in Star Wars Legends media here.

As for what book is worth picking up during this sale, that's entirely up to you. I'm personally drawn to the Complete Vehicles guide as it features cross-sections of iconic ships and land vehicles. As someone who loves building LEGO Star Wars sets, there's just something that appeals to me about knowing how these machines are actually designed to function.

articles.title: Here’s Why A Nightmare On Elm Street Game Hasn’t Happened In Decades
articles.summary: With Friday the 13th, Halloween, and other horror franchises getting video game adaptations in recent years, you might wonder when it'll be Freddy Krueger's turn, but according to Illfonic, the team behind those games, the task is harder than you might think.
body: With Freddy's dream world seeming like a great fit for a game, I'd long envisioned Elm Street as an obvious candidate for an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game akin to Illfonic's other titles, but listening to Gerritzen speak on the pitfalls, it occurred to me that he's right.

It's hard to imagine a game creating enough elaborate set-piece kills to keep them feeling fresh for players who may play for dozens or hundreds of hours, but neither does it make sense to rinse and repeat the same standout moments like Tina's nightmare that saw her crawling on the ceiling, or the way Glen's bed swallows him whole and erupts with a geyser of blood.

Freddy doesn't usually catch up to someone and finish them off with his iconic glove in a way that maps well onto multiplayer. He makes a meal out of them, and that's hard to translate into a game built on replayability.
Gerritzen explained that his team has worked on so many games of this sort that, by now, it gives them something like a running start.

articles.title: Rockstar Games Is Taking Down Footage and Images of Scrapped GTA 5 DLC And Early Version of Leaked GTA 6 Map
articles.summary: Take-Two Interactive, the parent company of Rockstar Games, has begun taking down videos and posts about leaked GTA 5 and GTA 6 content. Last week, a ton of files for Grand Theft Auto 5 leaked online.
body: Given that this material was illegally obtained in a hack and not officially released by Rockstar or datamined through the game's files, the studio's parent company, Take-Two Interactive, is working to scrub the assets from the internet. Various YouTube videos and posts with visuals of the leaked material or clips of the audio have been taken down by Take-Two. It doesn't seem like the company is going scorched-earth like it did for the GTA 6 leaks, but it does appear that content creators who post this material are at risk of copyright strikes.

We're just two months away from the release of GTA 6, and it's likely that Rockstar's security is going to be at an all-time high. The studio has been compromised by multiple leaks for the last four years, and now it's at a point where the game is likely finished and could be at risk of being spoiled. However, the lack of physical copies will make it a lot harder for things to leak ahead of its release. Given tons of footage managed to surface in August, though, it's not impossible for more things to make their way online.

articles.summary: Halloween is the latest in a long line of asymmetrical multiplayer horror games to release over the past decade, and like all the others, it's faced lots of comparisons to Dead by Daylight (DBD), the decade-long leader in the genre.
body: "It's literally cricket versus baseball. It's so easy to see an image of cricket and say it's exactly like baseball; it's like, really, is it? No, it's not. Like, here are all these differences," Gerritzen told me in a Zoom call. Illfonic is no stranger to this space, having made Friday the 13th, Predator: Hunting Grounds, Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed, and Killer Klowns from Outer Space all before Halloween.
"We make a game bespoke for that franchise, for that group of horror fans, and for the people who love that monster."
Gerritzen said that "others" make something more like "mixtapes," which have their own merits, but the projects are too different to directly compare, as some players do.

"And it's like, how could you not want something that is built purely for Halloween? Like, if you're a horror fan, if you're a Halloween fan, how would you just be okay with it being a secondary piece? We build things for that love of that movie, and I feel like they deserve it.

articles.title: Resident Evil Director Reacts To People Who Didn’t Like The Controversial Ending, Says It Was Almost Completely Different
articles.summary: The new Resident Evil movie from director Zach Cregger hit theaters on September 18, and it had a scary-good first weekend at the box office. The movie got great reviews but some people didn't like the ending specifically.
body: Cregger said in new interviews that he respects that, but doesn't agree--and the ending was almost totally different.

The Resident Evil movie ends by revealing that Austin Abrams' character, Bryan, becomes an infected demon after getting bitten by a child, and that the movie is actually the origin story of a monster that you might find in the games. The syringe carrying the cure to the virus shatters on the ground. In the original version, Cregger said the syringe with the cure also broke, but at that moment, Bryan simply went on a killing spree.

However, test screenings resulted in negative feedback, with people saying this was deflating and meant that the story was "over." However, Cregger told Collider that he filmed a second sequence as a Plan B, and that's the one that ended up in the movie where people root for Bryan to be cured. It led to a greater emotional journey for viewers, Cregger said, though not everyone agrees.
In a separate interview with The New Flesh Horror Movie Podcast, Cregger said he liked the idea of Bryan reaching his "final form" as a mutant monster, especially because it's not what you'd expect.

articles.title: When is the point of no return in Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave
articles.summary: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave 's deadline for getting new characters on your side might loom ominously on the horizon, but the game is more flexible than it lets on. There are a few points of no return, but only one of them is irreversible: the one at the start of Act 3.
body: The first deadline you'll encounter is November 27. This is when each Flame Lord's first part ends, and you have until the moment you start the final quest that day to recruit other characters. However, it's not a firm deadline like in Three Houses. After you clear that act, you can go back and replay any chapter in it. Replaying is helpful for recruiting other characters, training them differently, or completing paralogues, and there's no limit on how many times you can replay a chapter.

There is a catch, though. For the changes you make in your Act 1 replay to show up in later acts, you have to complete the rest of that Act 1 again. It's a bit tedious. If your goal is recruiting a character you missed, and you're going to play a second (or third or fourth) route anyway, we don't recommend replaying a chapter just to recruit someone. Instead, pick them up on whoever's route you play next.

articles.title: Destiny Isn’t Dead After All, Bungie Admits It Lost Sight Of What Players Loved
articles.summary: Bungie has admitted that it "lost sight" of what players loved about its games over the past few years, acknowledging that a series of broken promises and shifting promises caused the studio to lose the trust of its community.
body: In a new video accompanied by a blog post on the Bungie website, Bungie studio head Poria Torkan and Marathon head of product and general manager Josh Dean addressed the studio's recent struggles and outlined its plans for the future. Torkan acknowledges that Bungie's ambitions had stalled as the studio pursued too many different initiatives without enough focus on the things players actually want.
"We lost trust. We lost incredible colleagues. And our ambitions as a studio stalled," Torkan said. "We chased vision without enough focus on what players loved, and that's on us. We own that."

Bungie directly acknowledged the frustration surrounding Destiny 2--which received its last content update on June 9, 2026--including the removal of large amounts of content from the game in "sunsetting" processes.
"We haven't just heard your feedback. We understand the anger, the disappointment with us," Torkan said. "We're not asking for your trust, we know we have to earn it."

articles.summary: It's the end of an era for the man without fear. According to The Hollywood Reporter, Daredevil: Born Again 's forthcoming third season will also be its last.
body: Filming for Daredevil: Born Again wrapped two months ago, and it's currently in post-production. Showrunner Dario Scardapane and Marvel have "quietly parted ways," THR reported. Marvel reportedly did not renew his contract, and now it's not clear who will oversee the rest of post-production on the Disney Plus show.

Daredevil: Born Again is a sequel series to the original Netflix Daredevil show. The revival went through a turbulent development period, and was overhauled during the 2023 Hollywood strikes. Originally envisioned as an 18-episode series, Born Again was then split into two separate seasons before a third season was confirmed this time last year.

articles.title: YouTuber Logan Paul's Latest Pokémon Scheme Was A Total Flop
articles.summary: Just days after a bewildering visit to the Pentagon, controversial YouTuber Logan Paul embarked on a brand-new Pokémon ploy. His new venture would be tougher than anything he'd attempted before, he claimed — a list that includes selling a Pokémon card for a lot of money.
body: Shiny hunting refers to the practice of forcing a Pokémon game to generate a special monster. These monsters, called shinies, come in alternate colorways: A shiny Charizard, for example, has an edgy black and red coat. Shiny appearance rates vary from game to game, but they're normally extremely rare. Players have ways to improve their chances at catching one, but that could still mean spending weeks doing the same thing over and over again. Shiny hunting is not for the faint at heart, but Paul thought he was up for it.

His target, he announced on Sept. 18, would be an Onix that he wanted to evolve into a golden Shiny Steelix. Despite the eye-catching choice, the odds of finding a shiny Onix are merely 1 in 8,192. Still, Paul vowed that he would not stop his livestream until he found shiny Onix. "I could be hunting for days," Paul said.

articles.title: Weeks before GTA 6, Rockstar Games imposes new guidelines that restrict mods for missions, maps, updated storylines, and third-party IP
articles.summary: Ahead of the bottomless GTA 6 mods we'll surely get whenever the crime epic finally comes to PC, Rockstar Games has imposed new restrictions on the modding community and, boy, they are tight.
body: "Rockstar Games is the home of the Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption series, and other titles," the studio reminds us in its mod guidelines, which were updated earlier this month and spread around the internet more recently. "To maintain a fun, creative, and welcoming place for players and content creators, we encourage everyone to keep the following in mind."

The developer's first rule is to "respect our games." That means modders can no longer "expand or modify Rockstar Games' official storylines, plots, missions, characters, or other elements of our established continuity." Modders are also not allowed to combine maps or assets or characters from one Rockstar game with another - Arthur Morgan appearing in Vice City is probably a no-no, then.

"Multiplayer modding is limited to Rockstar Games' official licensed Creator Platform or else as otherwise licensed directly by Rockstar Games," it added. "Do not modify our games to operate on consoles, hardware devices, or other platforms where they have not been officially released by Rockstar Games."
points: Ahead of the bottomless GTA 6 mods we'll surely get whenever the crime epic finally comes to PC, Rockstar Games has imposed new restrictions on the modding community and, boy, they are tight.

articles.title: The Resident Evil Movie Is a Perfect Video Game Adaptation
articles.summary: On paper, Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil shouldn’t be very controversial. It’s not just the best reviewed Resident Evil adaptation of all time, but the best reviewed video game movie of all time by a country mile.
body: Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a courier who gets tasked with delivering an unknown medical package to Raccoon City. If you’ve played the games, you know where it’s going right away: Bryan ends up trying to survive in a zombie-infested town. No, it has nothing to do with STARS or Leon S. Kennedy, but the premise is very much faithful to the series’ spirit; it’s practically a side-story pulled right out of 2003’s Resident Evil Outbreak. That PS2 release was an anthology of survivor stories that included everyday people like a surgeon and a cowardly subway worker who isn’t that far off from Bryan.

articles.title: Nintendo Switch ports of Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire look even more likely after official account shares suspiciously HD footage of the GBA games
articles.summary: Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire might join their handheld third-generation siblings on a journey to the Nintendo Switch - at least, that's what fans think after an official channel posted what looks like a HD version of the classic games that are definitely not running on a Game Boy Advance.
body: Earlier today, an official Pokémon social media account shared a 30-second, suspiciously crisp clip of Wingull, the player-controlled trainer and Mr. Briney chasing each other around in Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire.

Alarm bells immediately went off in the brains of many Pokémon fans. "This is an official account tweeting out high-res gameplay from Pokemon Ruby/Sapphire," YouTuber That Bald Gamer tweeted. "Since these graphics aren't possible on their original official hardware, I'd say this essentially means Pokemon Ruby/Sapphire ports are coming to the Nintendo Switch in some fashion."

Adding more fuel to the fire is the fact that Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 recordings automatically captures footage from the last 30 seconds of gameplay, which is exactly how long the video above lasts. And official channels normally don't use emulated versions of older Pokémon games in promotional clips - the video above is almost definitely not from the games' original 2002 release.

articles.title: Bungie is freeing vaulted Destiny 2 campaigns after Marathon "did not reach as many players as we had hoped"
articles.summary: Bungie's been having a tough time these past few years, but the studio's new leadership is making big promises. Starting with Destiny 2 - the devs will start to let some of the game's older campaigns and raids out of the vault, while trying to build a future for the popular MMO-FPS hybrid.
body: "Bungie has been creating games for over 30 years and we have welcomed the communities that have formed around them. Over the last few years, we lost sight of that, and there have been real consequences. We lost trust, we lost incredible colleagues, and we lost sight of what we should be prioritizing most, our players," studio head Poria Torkan and head of product Josh Deane said in today's online statement. The duo then acknowledged fans probably won't start trusting "what we say today," but they're making moves to improve both Destiny and Marathon, regardless.

For context, earlier this year, Bungie laid off at least 290 employees shortly after waving goodbye to Destiny 2 with a final update. The studio's Marathon reboot hasn't been popular enough to fill the hole left by Destiny's absence, either. At the time, reports claimed there were no Destiny-related projects in active development, Destiny 3 included.
points: Bungie's been having a tough time these past few years, but the studio's new leadership is making big promises.
Starting with Destiny 2 - the devs will start to let some of the game's older campaigns and raids out of the vault, while trying to build a future for the popular MMO-FPS hybrid.

videos.title: Silent Hill: Townfall Review
videos.summary: Silent Hill: Townfall reviewed by Tristan Ogilvie on PlayStation 5. Also available on PC.
body: "Off the back of the more action-oriented sidestep of 2025’s Silent Hill f, Silent Hill: Townfall feels like Konami’s seminal survival horror series returning to what it does best. Its atmosphere is oppressively ominous, its central mystery is genuinely compelling to unravel and packed with themes that feel fresh, and its army of disfigured demons are exhilarating to both encounter and evade. The CRTV device that spots enemies hidden in your surroundings might slightly diminish the story’s ability to deliver major scares early on, but when Townfall eventually got me, it made sure it got me good. It also has some of the most cleverly designed and challenging puzzles I’ve experienced in any horror game in recent memory, many involving impeccable recreations of technology from yesteryear that really transported me back to its mid-nineties setting. Like the intravenous needle permanently jutting out of its hero’s wrist, Silent Hill: Townfall gives this long running series a welcome shot in the arm."

videos.summary: Thanks to Alienware for sponsoring DF Direct. To learn more about the Alienware AREA-51 Gaming Desktop, check out:
body: In a bit of a slow week for news, the team goes hands-on with a bunch of cool games to present their findings - principal amongst them being 007 First Light's visually stunning, but incredibly taxing path tracing upgrade. Redemption Road's 12-minute Kingmakers gameplay deep dive impresses the panel before Tom delivers his thoughts on Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave on Switch 2, with Oliver testing Diablo 4 also on the Nintendo hybrid. Meanwhile, reliable leaker Kepler_L2 says that we're only looking at one new GPU launch in 2027 - and it looks like the desktop version of the same GPU slated to appear in Microsoft's Project Helix...

videos.title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
videos.summary: Play Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter, now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch:
body: Armed with Joshua's harmonica and an unshakable determination, Estelle embarks upon a continent-spanning quest to find her partner.

During her journey, she must take on the sinister society of Ouroboros as it emerges from the shadows to plunge Liberl into utter chaos. Confronted with the greatest crisis in the history of the kingdom, Estelle and her allies battle to find Joshua and untangle the web of intrigue and conspiracy woven by Ouroboros!

videos.title: I strongly recommend: Control Resonant (Review)
videos.summary: Thanks to Nvidia for sponsoring the video. To learn more about how Nvidia tech delivers the best possible fidelity and performance in games like Control Resonant, click the link:
body: Control Resonant adopts the structure and aesthetic of a Ubisoft style open world game full of map markers and regional bosses, but whereas in a Ubisoft game the structure is the experience, here the structure is the beginning of a process that is specifically designed to subvert expectations. Rather than dictate the game's ultimate form, the structure is simply a scaffold that exists to let Remedy build other, more interesting things.
